
[pack0]

[level1]

tip1=HELLO! LET'S START TRAINING.
    TABLETS WILL HELP YOU TO MASTER THE GAME AND ADVISE HOW TO OVERCOME DIFFICULTIES. YOU ONLY NEED TO COME UP TO THE TABLET, PRESS "USE" BUTTON (SPACE BAR BY DEFAULT) AND YOU WILL SEE A TIP. NOW PLEASE FOLLOW THE ARROW LEADING TO THE NEXT TABLET, IT IS NOT FAR.

tip2=TRY TO CONTROL DINO. NOTE THAT YOU RUN ASLANT. AT THIS LEVEL YOU WILL NOT ENCOUNTER ANY DIFFICULTIES, JUST TRAIN IN MOVING AND GETTING ROUND OBSTACLES. LEADING ARROWS WILL HELP YOU TO MOVE IN THE RIGHT DIRECTION.

tip3=YOUR MAIN WEAPON IN THIS GAME IS, OF COURSE, YOUR HEAD. WITH ITS HELP YOU WILL MASTER SEVERAL DINO'S SKILLS. FOR A START MASTER A SKILL OF A SHOT-FIRER.

tip4=YOU'VE TAKEN MAGIC BOMBS - BALLS WITH EXPLOSIVE FILLING. PLEASE LOOK AT THE SYMBOLS AND NUMBERS AT THE LEFT LOWER CORNER OF THE SCREEN. NOW YOU HAVE SEVERAL YELLOW BOMBS. YOU CAN HAVE SOME BOMBS FROM THE VERY BEGINNING OF THE LEVEL. NOW RUN TO THE NEXT TIP.

tip5=THERE ARE THREE TYPES OF MAGIC BOMBS YOU MUST LEARN HOW TO USE. LET'S START FROM THE FIRST TYPE, YOU HAVE NO OTHER BOMBS YET.
    SO, YELLOW BOMBS. TRY TO RUN TO THE CENTER OF THE CLEARING AND PRESS "FIRE" (LEFT CTRL BY DEFAULT), AND THEN RUN AWAY QUICKLY! AFTER SEVERAL SECONDS THE BOMB WILL EXPLODE, IF YOU ARE NEAR, YOU CAN SUFFER. MAKE SOME TRAINING - EXPLODE THE BOMBS YOU HAVE NOW AND RUN TO THE NEXT TIP.

tip6=YOU CAN EXPLODE SOME FRAGILE OBSTACLES ON YOUR WAY BY THE BOMBS, LIKE WICKETS AND WOODEN FENCES. TO EXPLODE A WICKET, COME CLOSE TO IT, SET THE BOMB AND RUN AWAY TO A SAFE DISTANCE. EXPLODE THE WICKET AND PASS THROUGH TO THE NEXT TIP.

tip7=HERE COMES THE FIRST MONSTER. DON'T BE AFRAID, NOW HE IS SAFELY CLOSED IN A TRAP. MEET A SHORTY. HE IS MALICIOUS, SILLY AND LOVES EATING, THAT IS WHY HE NEVER LEAVES HIS FORK. LATER ON YOU WILL DEAL WITH FAR MORE DANGEROUS ENEMIES. SET THE BOMB IN FRONT OF THE GRATE AND RUN AWAY. THE SHORTY WILL BURST! NOTE THAT THE GRATE WILL LET THE EXPLOSION GO THROUGH AND REMAIN INTACT.

tip8=TELEPORT WILL TRANSFER YOU TO THE NEXT LEVEL. NOTE: A SPELL CAST OVER THE TELEPORT DOES NOT LET IT TRANSFER ALIENS, AND IF THERE STILL IS AT LEAST ONE MONSTER AT THE LEVEL, THE TELEPORT WILL NOT WORK. THAT IS WHY YOU WILL HAVE TO CLEAR THE LEVEL FROM ALL THE MONSTERS TO GO FURTHER.
    IF YOU FEEL THAT YOU'VE GOT ENOUGH TRAINING IN CONTROLLING, FEEL FREE TO COME INSIDE.


[level2]

tip1=LET'S CONTINUE.
    TRY TO EXPLODE A SHORTY. YOU HAVE 10 YELLOW BOMBS NOW. EXPLODE THE GATE THAT HIDES THE SHORTY AND FIGHT THE MONSTER. THEN EXPLODE THE FENCE HIDING THE WAY TO THE NEXT TIP.

tip2=IF YOU HAVE SPENT SOME STAMINA IN YOUR FIGHT WITH THE SHORTY, EAT SOME APPLES OR A PINEAPPLE. DINO LOVES FRUITS. A QUARTER OF AN APPLE RESTORES A LITTLE STAMINA, A HALF - SOME MORE, AND THE WHOLE APPLE - FAR MORE. A PINEAPPLE RESTORES DINO'S STAMINA FULLY (UP TO 100 UNITS). IF YOU HAVE GOOD STAMINA, LEAVE APPLES AND PINEAPPLES FOR FUTURE, TO COME BACK AND EAT SOME, WHEN YOU NEED IT.

tip3=THE KEY OPENS THE GATE WITH A BIG LOCK ON IT. YOU WILL SEE THE GATE LATER. KEYS AND OTHER OBJECTS DINO HAS ARE DISPLAYED AT THE BOTTOM OF THE SCREEN AS ICONS WITH A NUMBER NEAR IT - THE QUANTITY OF EACH OBJECT (KEYS, FOR EXAMPLE).

tip4=DINO CAN MOVE SOME OBJECTS - SET YOURSELF AGAINST THE BOX AND PUSH.

tip5=YOU CAN EXPLODE WOODEN BOXES, THERE CAN BE VARIOUS GOODIES INSIDE.

tip6=THIS IS A BARREL. IT IS FILLED WITH EXPLOSIVES AND WILL EXPLODE IF YOU SET A BOMB NEAR. BE CAREFUL, THE BARREL EXPLOSION IS VERY STRONG!
    YOU CAN MOVE THE BARREL JUST LIKE BOXES. YOU CAN ALSO EXPLODE MONSTERS WITH IT. MOVE THE BARREL TOWARDS SHORTIES AND EXPLODE IT.

tip7=COME UP TO THE GATE FACING IT. IF YOU HAVE THE KEY, ITS ICON AT THE BOTTOM OF THE SCREEN WILL START BLINKING. PRESS THE "USE" BUTTON (SPACE BY DEFAULT), AND THE DOORS WILL OPEN.

tip8=LOOK FOR THE TELEPORT! IT IS SOMEWHERE IN THE WOOD.

tip9=GO STRAIGHT OUT! ANOTHER LESSON IS WAITING FOR YOU...


[level3]

tip1=LET'S MASTER ANOTHER IMPORTANT TRICK: EVEN WHEN YOU DO NOT HAVE ANY BOMBS, YOU CAN FIGHT MONSTERS - YOU CAN KICK THEM! TO DO THIS RUN CLOSE TO A SHORTY AND PRESS "USE" BUTTON (SPACE BY DEFAULT). TRY TO KICK THE SHORTY DOWN. TO DO THIS EXPLODE THE PASSAGE AND RUN BRAVELY STRAIGHT AT THE ENEMY.

tip2=YOU'VE TAKEN NEW BOMBS - BLUE, RADIO-CONTROLLED. ANOTHER ICON APPEARED AT THE BOTTOM OF THE SCREEN. NOW TRY TO SWITCH BETWEEN ACTIVE BOMB TYPE. PRESS "NEXT WEAPON" BUTTON FOR SWITCHING (LEFT SHIFT BY DEFAULT). SHIFT THE TYPES AND RUN TO THE NEXT TIP.

tip3= BLUE BOMBS ARE RADIO-CONTROLLED. SWITCH TO THEM. PRESS "FIRE", THE BLUE BOMB WILL SET. RUN AWAY AND PRESS "FIRE" AGAIN. THE BOMB WILL EXPLODE. BLUE BOMBS ARE GOOD FOR CATCHING THE ALIENS BY SURPRISE. GET SOME TRAINING: EXPLODE EVERYTHING AT HAND AND RUN TO THE NEXT TIP.

tip4=IN GENERAL, YOU'D BETTER NOT WASTE YOUR BOMBS. SOMETIMES YOU WILL GET INTO SUCH A FIX WHEN EVERY BOMB WILL COUNT.

tip5=GO LEFT AND FIND A TELEPORT, GO RIGHT AND FIGHT ALIENS. GO RIGHT, THEN LEFT, BECAUSE THE TELEPORT WILL NOT WORK WHILE AT LEAST ONE ALIEN IS STILL ALIVE. FIND A KEY THERE TO OPEN THE GATE CLOSING THE PASSAGE TO THE TELEPORT.

tip6=THERE ARE CASES WHEN YOU REALIZE THAT YOU MUST START A LEVEL ALL OVER AGAIN. IF YOU DECIDE TO RESTART A LEVEL, PRESS "ESC" AND CHOOSE "RESTART LEVEL"

tip7=NEW MONSTERS, PRIZES, NEW BOMBS AND VARIOUS DEVICES WAIT FOR YOU FURTHER IN THE GAME. YOU WILL HAVE SOMETHING TO LEARN! SO DON'T FORGET ABOUT TABLETS WITH TIPS.

tip8=THE TRAINING IS OVER. IT'S TIME TO START THE REAL GAME. GOOD LUCK!

tip9=BE CAREFUL, BONUS-BOMBS-CAN DETONATE FROM THE NEAR EXPLOSION.




[pack1]


[level1]

[level2]

tip1= AT THIS LEVEL YOU WILL MEET A NEW ALIEN - A SNIPER. HE IS ARMED WITH A PLASMA GUN AND AN AIMING DEVICE BUILT INTO HIS RIGHT EYE. DON'T GET INTO HIS SIGHT!

tip2=THIS IS AN ALIEN LASER. THE LASER IS TURNED OFF NOW, TO POWER IT ON YOU WILL HAVE TO INSERT A BATTERY INTO IT. FIND A BATTERY AND COME CLOSE TO THE LASER, SO THAT ITS ICON STARTS BLINKING. PRESS "USE" BUTTON.

[level3]

tip1=SPECIAL MIRRORS REFLECT LASER RAYS. YOU CAN MOVE THE MIRRORS JUST LIKE BOXES AND BARRELS. POWER ON THE LASER WITH HELP OF THE BATTERY AND MOVE ONE OF THE MIRRORS TO THE RAY. THE RAY WILL BE REFRACTED. THINK HOW YOU CAN FIGHT SNIPERS WITHOUT BOMBS. NOTE: WHEN A LASER RAY REACHES A BARREL IT EXPLODES. AND THE MAIN THING: A LASER RAY IS DANGEROUS BOTH FOR ALIENS AND FOR DINO. DON'T GET CAUGHT!

[level4]

tip1=SNIPERS ARE NOT VERY INTELLIGENT, BUT RATHER DANGEROUS GUYS. IT WILL BE VERY UNPLEASANT FOR DINO TO CATCH A STRAY BULLET, SHOT BY ONE OF THEM. BUT NOW YOU HAVE RED BOMBS IN STORE! PRESS "FIRE" - THE BOMB WILL SPRING FORWARD, LIKE A BALL, AND EXPLODE AS SOON AS IT MEETS AN OBSTACLE ON ITS WAY. AN EXCELLENT WEAPON AGAINST ALIENS! BUT BE CAREFUL - IT IS EASY TO SUFFER FROM RED BOMBS YOURSELF, USE THEM VERY CAREFULLY NEAR MONSTERS AND OBSTACLES.

[level5]

tip1=BE READY TO MEET LONGWISES! THOSE LONGWISES ARE VERY LOATHSOME, DANGEROUS AND ARTFUL CREATURES. THEY ARE ARMED WITH ELECTRON-BEAM PISTOLS, WHICH FIRE LIGHTNINGS. RED BOMBS WILL HELP DINO TO WIN!



[pack2]


[level1]

[level2]

tip1=WHEN YOU HAVE NO BOMBS, YOU WILL HAVE TO USE ANYTHING AVAILABLE. USE ALIEN LASERS AGAINST THE ALIENS.

[level3]

tip1=YOU WILL MEET A NEW MONSTER AT THIS LEVEL - A BOUNCER. MEETING A BOUNCER'S FIST  WILL BE HARDLY A PLEASANT EXPERIENCE FOR DINO. SO - LOOK OUT! SEEING A MONSTER, RUN ASIDE IF YOU DO NOT WANT TO SERVE AS A BOXER'S PUNCH BAG.

[level4]

tip1=MAGIC HAT MAKES DINO INVISIBLE FOR MONSTERS, WHEN HE PUTS IT ON. WHEN DINO TAKES A MAGIC WATCH, THE TIME SLOWS DOWN FOR HIM AND HE STARTS RUNNING TWO TIMES FASTER. SPEEDING-UP CONTINUES FOR ABOUT 10 SECONDS.

[level5]

[level6]

tip1=THINK TWICE WHAT TO DO BEFORE YOU START. DINO HAS ONLY ONE BOMB AT THE BEGINNING OF THE LEVEL.

[level7]

tip1=HERE YOU WILL HAVE TO USE YOU BRAIN: ALIENS BLOCKED THE PASSAGE TO THE TELEPORT BY A LASER AND PUT A LONGWISE ON GUARD. AND BY ILL LUCK DINO DOES NOT HAVE ANY BOMBS. BUT THERE ARE IRON BOXES NEARBY WHICH ALIEN USED FOR LASERS TRANSPORTATION.

[level8]

tip1=PLACE THE BARRELS CORRECTLY: THE BARREL WILL EXPLODE THE FENCE AND THE WICKET BEHIND IT ONLY IF YOU SET IT RIGHT IN FRONT OF THE FENCE. ONLY AFTER YOU'VE PLACED THE BARRELS, POWER THE LASER ON.

[level1]

tip1=THE ALIENS ARE FRIGHTENED! THEY UNDERSTOOD THEY CANNOT FIGHT DINO BY STRENGTH AND RESORTED TO CUNNING. BY LASERS AND MIRRORS ALIENS HID THE TELEPORT ON THE ISLAND AND THOUGHT THE LITTLE DINOSAUR WOULD STICK THERE FOR A LONG TIME. USING YOUR WITS AND PATIENCE, TRY TO REACH THE TELEPORT.
